page.overview:
Who is Aster?

Not to be confused with Astor, a character from Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity

If speaks to her again later, he can ask about either himself or the dance. will tell the hero that is a carpenter and how he can find him behind the . Apparently, is also a "luminary in his field," but does not fully understand that title. She also says she heard he was a construction company, but she is not sure how that is possible. In addition, may share she heard that is a famous president or designer. No matter what she says, will direct to so he can see the dance for himself.

Asking about the dance will prompt to demonstrate it to . However, telling her to stop will upset , and she will call him lame. When it , will run to the nearby and pretend to . She plays with a mound of material as though kneading it like dough.

At 8 o'clock, goes home to go to bed. She will also remark that if she does not get home soon, she will get in trouble. As she sleeps, she dreams about her absent mother.
